name: Mailbox
description: Self-hosted email: receiving, forwarding, local mailboxes, webmail reader, IMAP sync, DKIM/SRS
author: Joinery

provisioners.label: Inbound mail server
provisioners.details: Provider-specific. For Postfix, verifies port 25 is listening locally. For webhook providers (Mailgun, etc.) this is informational — the provider's own infrastructure handles MX.

provisioners.label: Sending route
provisioners.details: The route outgoing mail takes: the active provider's credential, or an SMTP host. Unrelated to the ingest relay.

provisioners.label: DNS records for inbound domains
provisioners.details: Each enabled inbound domain needs an MX record pointing here and an SPF record.

provisioners.label: Sealed mailbox search index (ext-sqlite3 + FTS5)
provisioners.details: A vault-holding mailbox's sender/subject/body columns are ciphertext at rest and cannot be searched in SQL; MailboxIndex builds a disposable, in-window-only FTS5 index instead.

provisioners.label: Spam scanner on this server
provisioners.details: Ships with the mail stack: install_email.sh installs rspamd + redis unconditionally, so spam learning can be enabled later as a pure settings toggle. Verified answering, and wired into Postfix's milter chain where this server receives mail directly. A box with no local mail stack (webhook-only, relay-fronted from birth) needs none and is not checked. provision_spam_scanner.sh install repairs drift; boxes provisioned before the scanner shipped with the stack get it the same way.

provisioners.label: Hardened relay tunnel
provisioners.details: When sent mail leaves through the relay, compose sends travel over WireGuard. Runs a real SMTP submission handshake over the tunnel (EHLO, MAIL FROM, RCPT to a reserved domain, QUIT — nothing is sent): port 25 listens in both modes, so only accepting relay of an external recipient proves the submission listener is open. Fails until a relay provisioned inbound-only is rebuilt to carry sent mail. No-op when sent mail leaves through a provider, and on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Relay spool draining
provisioners.details: The main box pulls sealed mail off the relay spool every cron pass. Verifies a pull ran in the last 30 minutes so sealed mail is reaching the inbox. No-op on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Relay alias map fresh
provisioners.details: The relay validates recipients against a synced alias map. Verifies the map the relay is running matches the current domains/aliases, so a newly created alias is not bounced. No-op on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Origin IP not in mail DNS
provisioners.details: Once a relay exists, the main box IP must not appear in any hosted domain's mail DNS (a single leak defeats the hidden origin). Checks every hosted domain's MX. No-op on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: Sent mail leaves via an API provider
provisioners.details: When sent mail leaves through a provider (the default), compose sends use that provider's HTTP API so the box IP never enters the Received chain. Verifies that provider submits over an API, not SMTP. No-op when sent mail leaves through the relay, or on colocated deployments.

provisioners.label: No origin leak in sent mail
provisioners.details: Scans the delivered headers of the most recent out-and-back origin-leak probe for the main box IP or hostname. No-op when sent mail leaves through the relay, on colocated deployments, or until a probe has been round-tripped (run one from the Relay tab).

settings.name: mailbox_relay_cutover_complete
settings.label: Relay cutover complete
settings.helptext: Set once inbound mail is confirmed arriving through the relay. Until then the direct path stays live.

settings.name: mailbox_receive_mode
settings.label: How this deployment receives mail
settings.helptext: Set by the Setup tab when a relay is connected. Changing it here does not move any mail.

settings.name: mailbox_from_show_via
settings.label: Show via Site Name in the From line of forwarded mail
settings.helptext: Off shows just the original sender name. The From address is the site verified address either way, which deliverability requires; the original sender stays in Reply-To.

settings.name: mailbox_trash_retention_days
settings.label: Trash retention (days)
settings.helptext: Mail in Trash is permanently deleted after this many days. 0 keeps it indefinitely.

settings.name: mailbox_log_retention_days
settings.helptext: How long the inbound delivery log is kept for troubleshooting. Stored mail has its own window above. 0 keeps the log indefinitely.
settings.label: Delivery-log retention (days)

settings.name: mailbox_forwarding_rate_limit_per_alias
settings.label: Forwards per alias, per window
settings.helptext: Messages allowed per alias within the window. 0 disables the per-alias limit.

settings.name: mailbox_forwarding_rate_limit_per_domain
settings.label: Forwards per domain, per window
settings.helptext: Messages allowed per domain within the window. 0 disables the per-domain limit.

settings.name: mailbox_forwarding_rate_limit_window
settings.label: Rate-limit window (seconds)
settings.helptext: Rolling window the per-alias and per-domain limits are counted over.

settings.name: mailbox_srs_secret
settings.label: SRS Secret
settings.helptext: Random secret used to sign and verify SRS-rewritten addresses. Required when SRS is enabled.

settings.name: mailbox_mail_hostname
settings.label: Mail hostname
settings.helptext: The name this server gives in SMTP, e.g. mail.example.com.

settings.name: mailbox_public_ip
settings.label: Public IP
settings.helptext: The address other mail servers see. Used to build the SPF and PTR guidance.

settings.name: mailbox_max_per_window
settings.label: Max stored messages per domain, per window

settings.name: mailbox_provider
settings.label: Active inbound provider
settings.helptext: How the platform receives inbound mail. Postfix (self-hosted) handles MX locally; webhook providers deliver over HTTP POST.

settings.name: mailbox_spam_filtering_enabled
settings.label: Move suspected spam to the Spam view
settings.helptext: Suspected spam is moved out of the inbox and is not forwarded. It is never rejected, bounced or deleted, so a wrong guess costs a click.

settings.name: mailbox_spam_learning_enabled
settings.label: Learn from what users mark as spam
settings.helptext: Corrections in the reader train a spam filter on this deployment own mail, and its answer then outranks the upstream scanner's — which is what lets marking a message not spam bring it back. What it learns is yours alone — a shared relay is deliberately stateless and cannot learn for you.

settings.name: mailbox_rspamd_controller_url
settings.label: Rspamd controller URL
settings.helptext: Where the spam scanner's controller listens, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:11334.

settings.name: mailbox_relay_wg_public_key
settings.label: Relay WireGuard public key
settings.helptext: This deployment's tunnel key, as the relay knows it.

settings.name: mailbox_relay_outbound_mode
settings.label: Sent mail leaves through
settings.helptext: Through the relay means no third party carries your sent mail, and this deployment owns the relay IP's sending reputation. A change takes effect on the relay at its next Rebuild.

settings.name: mailbox_fleet_service_url
settings.label: Relay service URL
settings.helptext: The service this deployment rents its relay spot from. Enrolment itself happens on the Setup tab.

settings.name: mailbox_fleet_service_enabled
settings.label: Run a hosted relay fleet
settings.helptext: Turn on to let other deployments enrol with this one as their relay. This is the fleet operator side; a deployment that only wants to use someone else relay leaves it off.

settings.name: mailbox_fleet_mx_zone
settings.label: Fleet MX zone
settings.helptext: A DNS zone you control. Each tenant MX hostname is <slug>.<zone>, with slug in the form t<id>, published by you as an A record pointing at that tenant shard.

settings.name: mailbox_fleet_grace_days
settings.label: Grace period (days)
settings.helptext: How long mail keeps flowing after the relay subscription lapses.

settings.name: mailbox_import_enabled
settings.label: Mail archive import enabled
settings.helptext: Lets members bring an existing mailbox in from an exported file. Turning this off also stops runs already underway from advancing.

settings.name: mailbox_import_batch_size
settings.label: Messages imported per pass
settings.helptext: How many messages one scheduled-task pass stores. Higher finishes sooner and holds the runner longer.

settings.name: mailbox_import_max_concurrent
settings.label: Imports underway at once
settings.helptext: Across the whole deployment, so one large archive cannot starve everyone else's mail.

settings.name: mailbox_import_archive_retention_days
settings.label: Keep a finished import's archive for (days)
settings.helptext: How long the uploaded archive is kept after an import finishes, so it can be undone and re-run. 0 keeps archives indefinitely. Archives picked from a member's own Drive are never deleted, only released.

mail_import.scanned.label: Mail archive ready to choose
mail_import.scanned.description: An archive import finished reading and is waiting for the user to choose which folders to bring in. Nothing is stored until they do.

payload.mailbox: Address of the mailbox it will import into
payload.found: How many messages the scan found
payload.recipients: The run's owner — the only person who can answer

notify.body_template: Found {found} message(s) for {mailbox}. Choose which folders to bring in — nothing is stored until you do.

mail_import.finished.label: Mail archive import finished
mail_import.finished.description: An archive import finished storing the selected mail.

payload.mailbox: Address of the mailbox it imported into
payload.failed: Messages that could not be read

mailbox.relay_scanner_down.label: Relay stopped scanning for spam
mailbox.relay_scanner_down.description: The relay that receives your mail is no longer delivering spam verdicts. Raised once when it happens, not repeatedly while it stays broken.

payload.reason: Which fault it is: dead, unwired or drift
payload.detail: What the relay reported, in plain terms
payload.coverage: Whether this server is scanning the mail itself in the meantime

mailbox.relay_scanner_recovered.label: Relay is scanning for spam again
mailbox.relay_scanner_recovered.description: The relay that receives your mail is delivering spam verdicts again.

payload.detail: What the relay reported, in plain terms
payload.coverage: Whether this server is scanning the mail itself as well

notify.title_template: {relay_name} is scanning mail for spam again
